title: UMSF Firmware Laboratory: A Self-Contained Colab Companion for ESP32/BLE Protocols and Native Logic

creators.name: Beketova, Gulzhanat
creators.affiliation: Almaty University of Energy and Communications

description: An English, self-contained computational laboratory accompanying umsf-ble-firmware 1.0.0. The notebook embeds the original source and builds its portable C/C++ libraries, runs all original host tests and supplied protocol vectors, and generates 30 explanatory figures with PNG/SVG exports. Controlled native experiments examine physiological feature quality, null sentinels, explicitly synthetic HR, stationary detector rules, gas warmup and hysteresis, tilt uncertainty, SOS debounce, link freshness, RAM-buffer priorities and application acknowledgements. Protocol experiments inspect CRC corruption and native BLE fragmentation. Includes clean and executed notebooks, a rendered HTML report, CSV traces, source provenance, validation evidence, citation metadata and MIT license. All experimental sensor inputs are synthetic. ESP32 firmware images are not compiled or hardware-validated in this release; hosted Google Colab frontend execution has not been directly tested. After a three-cell setup, every analysis cell is self-sufficient and can run alone, in any order or after a kernel restart. The notebook is verified locally in a fresh Jupyter kernel with only the notebook supplied, and each analysis cell alone in its own fresh kernel. Thresholds are uncalibrated; no clinical, gas-concentration, structural-safety or causal-attribution claims are made.
notes: Notebook companion 1.2.0 (optimized; every analysis cell self-sufficient); original firmware source 1.0.0 preserved byte-for-byte. See results/VALIDATION_REPORT.json. No DOI assigned by this package.
